criteria.text: The shipping mobile client exposes exactly three primary tabs named Agents, Tools, and Settings; chat, workspace, and terminal remain reusable contextual Agent routes.
criteria.test_id: issue-1172-c1: navigation exposes exactly Agents Tools and Settings

criteria.text: Agents supports all/project-filtered active, completed, and archived chats with create, open, rename, archive, restore, fork, and confirmed delete actions plus nested child sessions.
criteria.test_id: issue-1172-c2: chat read model filters projects and lifecycle states while preserving children

criteria.text: Reconnect handling deduplicates stable event IDs and performs an authoritative transcript, status, todo, diff, and child refresh with bounded exponential backoff.
criteria.test_id: issue-1172-c3: recovery dedupes stable event IDs and bounds retry delays

criteria.text: Offline chat caches contain only secret-free read models, remain read-only, and all mutations are disabled until the paired host reconnects.
criteria.test_id: issue-1172-c4: offline cache strips secrets and mutation guard fails closed

criteria.text: GET /agent-activity aggregates human, scheduler, webhook, research, cookbook, and optimizer executions from existing records without creating a duplicate execution table.
criteria.test_id: issue-1172-c5: aggregates all execution sources without a duplicate activity table

criteria.text: Activity ordering, source/status normalization, filtering, and opaque cursor pagination are canonical, stable, and duplicate-free.
criteria.test_id: issue-1172-c6: canonical order filters and cursor remain stable and duplicate-free

criteria.text: Activity renders active, waiting, failed, and completed items with source labels and transcript/result deep links when the underlying record supplies one.
criteria.test_id: issue-1172-c7: activity feed normalizes states and only emits valid deep links

criteria.text: Loading, empty, offline-cache, expired-auth, forbidden, and retryable-error states are accessible, dark-mode compatible, and Dynamic Type safe.
criteria.test_id: issue-1172-c8: reusable screen states cover the full resilient state set

criteria.text: A live sandboxed API test proves the authenticated agent-activity route reads real persisted source records and paginates without duplicates.
criteria.test_id: issue-1172-c9: live sandbox returns authenticated persisted activity without duplicate pages

criteria.text: Research, schedule, webhook, and cookbook Activity items navigate to supported mobile tool routes and visibly open the exact selected target rather than a nonexistent path.
criteria.test_id: issue-1172-c10: Activity tool links open the selected supported target UI
